integrity: Analytical universal proof and exact-rational complete-column checks for four explicit designs (346 columns); mathematical novelty assessed against identified literature with residual risk of less-indexed equivalent results; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Existing nontrivial symmetric 2-designs only, with pair replication between two and block size minus two inclusive; real unweighted incidence graphs; canonical Euclidean-orthogonal cut and cycle projections; no claims for general 2-designs, arbitrary projection constants, intermediate endpoint exponents, or existence of parameter configurations.
title: Universal endpoint Hodge norms for symmetric design incidence graphs
